purpose: performance enhancement: avoid unchanged GPU block-table destination writes
status: harness-only prototype; no serving runtime patch and no new GPU timing or correctness result

provided_control_identity.classification: PR-declared immutable identity; no image or hardware inspected in this review

intended_invariants: Destination ownership changes, replacement generation changes and count shrinkage force correct row/tail reconstruction.
Append-only growth updates the required span or coalesced chunks without scanning the full host page table.
Overwrite generations and counts are published after the corresponding source IDs.
Dummy writes, alternate destinations that may alias the default, and layout rebuilds invalidate cached destination state.
Capture-visible destination addresses remain stable and downstream consumers observe the current row contents.

provided_evidence.classification: PR-provided CPU/offline summaries, not independently repeated or raw-audited here
provided_evidence.component_matrix_authored_not_run: row/chunk/span by 32K/64K/256K/512K/1M by c1/c8/c16; two fresh benchmark processes with independent correctness processes
limits: The original operation screen uses actual extracted producer/staging functions but Python reference device/gather operations; it does not execute the new GPU kernel.
The three host tests exercise prototype method bodies with a fake base and fake UVA publication; they are not device or model evidence.
Historical Triton-to-TileLang gather savings and historical profiled exposure are retained references, not measurements of this cache prototype.
No new component performance, preserved-performance, native-output, rank agreement, full-step or end-to-end serving result exists.
The missing-prepared-input build-check exit is an unfinished preparation result, not a performance rejection.

prototype_source_review.finding: The inspected owner/generation/count reset protocol, per-CTA state publication barrier, dummy invalidation, alternate-output fallback and layout reset address the named invalidations. This limited review cannot establish GPU memory safety or native correctness.
prototype_source_review.remaining_runtime_integration: A surviving variant still needs an actual source-fork patch, prepared-kernel declarations, all direct source/destination writers accounted for, and integration with real input-buffer lifetimes. The prototype itself explicitly does not claim those steps are complete.

focused_execution_packet_rework.priority: P1 before launch under the owner's explicit resource-bounds requirement
focused_execution_packet_rework.issue: The published component bundle and its inherited bundle_command have no actual CPU or memory/no-extra-swap cgroup bounds and no compile-worker/thread cap. The subprocess wall-clock timeouts bound elapsed time only, despite the packet describing a bounded component screen.
focused_execution_packet_rework.minimum_fix: Use the normal exact-owned coordinated controller and an explicitly bounded component container/job, with CPU, memory, swap and worker/thread limits applied to the actual worker and recorded/inspected before execution. Keep existing hardware/thermal limits, shared queue order and native tests unchanged; no new cache implementation is needed for this control repair.
focused_execution_packet_rework.regression_needed: Verify the rendered launch applies actual worker/container bounds and preserves them across both fresh correctness/benchmark processes, without relying on client-only caps or elapsed timeouts.

ownership_and_overlay_review.finding: The specification does not acquire a window or alter serving. Its documented queue order yields to the collective and verification-budget reservations and earlier legitimate claims. A future run still requires an actual exact-owned lease, all-rank identity/guards and verified restoration before release.
ownership_and_overlay_review.limitations: Two fresh component processes are not two serving boots. Historical few-microsecond gather costs and aggregate exposure cannot establish the current long-context opportunity or predict end-to-end benefit.

disposition: Retain the unique unmeasured enhancement and its active implementation. Correct the bounded execution packet before hardware screening; do not reject the cache idea for missing build inputs or substitute historical savings for a new result. A component survivor requires separate native/runtime and boot-repeat serving qualification.
review_scope: Lightweight primary prototype/harness, inherited dispatch and provided small-summary review only
